description: This file defines the ControlPlaneMemoryBackend struct and its associated methods for interacting with a distributed memory backend via HTTP API endpoints under '/api/v1/memory/*'. It implements methods for setting, getting, deleting, listing, and searching memory entries, as well as handling vector embeddings. The file is specific to a control plane memory backend component within a larger SDK or system.

classes.name: ControlPlaneMemoryBackend
classes.description: Struct implementing a distributed memory backend that communicates with a control plane via REST API. It provides methods to set, get, delete, list, and search memory items, including support for vector embeddings, with scope awareness and access control headers.

methods.name: NewControlPlaneMemoryBackend
methods.description: Constructor function to instantiate a new ControlPlaneMemoryBackend with a specified control plane URL, token, and agent node ID.

methods.name: Set
methods.description: Sends a request to store a key-value pair in the memory backend within a specified scope and scope ID.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves a value from the memory backend for a given key within a scope and scope ID.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes a key from the memory backend within a specified scope and scope ID.

methods.name: List
methods.description: Lists all keys in the memory backend for a given scope and scope ID.

methods.name: SetVector
methods.description: Stores an embedding vector along with metadata for a specific key in the memory backend.

methods.name: GetVector
methods.description: Retrieves an embedding vector and associated metadata for a specific key.

methods.name: SearchVector
methods.description: Performs a vector similarity search within the scope, returning top-k results.

methods.name: DeleteVector
methods.description: Deletes a vector embedding associated with a key.

methods.name: applyHeaders
methods.description: Applies necessary headers, including authorization and scope identifiers, to HTTP requests.

methods.name: apiScope
methods.description: Converts internal scope enumeration to API scope string.

methods.name: mustJSONReader
methods.description: Utility function to marshal an object to JSON and return an io.Reader.
